@metadata.comment: English UI messages. Banana format: https://github.com/wikimedia/banana-i18n

shell-welcome: A quiet place to write your novel.
settings-save-failed: Your settings couldn't be saved. They'll apply until you close Plot Device.
dialog-new-project-location: Choose where to create the project
dialog-backup-location: Choose where to keep the backup
welcome-bring-in-question: Already have notes or a draft?
new-project-hint: Outlines and names are written in the book's language.
new-project-adjust-later: Everything can be changed later: the kinds of pages, the outlines, the names.
template-novel-description: Chapters, characters, places and notes, with a three-act outline.
template-short-story-description: One chapter, ready to write, and a short outline.
template-campaign-description: Sessions instead of chapters; NPCs, locations, factions, items and lore.
template-blank-description: Chapters, characters, places and notes, and nothing else.
open-failed-not-a-project: This folder isn't a Plot Device project. Choose a folder that has a project.md file.
open-failed-unreadable: This project couldn't be read. Nothing was changed.
open-failed-newer-format: This project was made with a newer version of Plot Device.
open-failed-not-recent: That project is no longer in the recent list.
create-failed-folder-exists: A folder with that name is already there.
create-failed-inside-project: Choose a place outside another project.
write-empty-unit-text: Start writing; you can name it now or later.
navigator-no-chapters: This book has no chapters yet.
write-empty-text: A book is written one chapter at a time. Start the first; you can name it now or later.
change-failed-stale: The contents changed in another app. They have been reloaded; please try again.
change-failed-name-taken: Another file already has that name.
change-failed-invalid-name: That name can't be used for a file.
change-failed: That change couldn't be made. Nothing was changed.
chapter-unreadable: This chapter can't be shown: it isn't valid text, or its details are damaged. Nothing in it will be changed.
save-failed: Couldn't save. Your text is kept here, and saving will try again as you type.
plain-text-banner: Plain text. Changes here are saved exactly as typed.
conflict-title: This chapter changed in another app
conflict-body: While you were writing, “$1” was changed outside Plot Device. Your newest text hasn't been saved over it.
conflict-keep-both-detail: Your text is saved as a new file next to the chapter, and the chapter shows the other version.
conflict-use-mine-detail: Your text replaces the other version. The other changes will be lost.
conflict-kept: Your text was saved as “$1”, under On the side.
conflict-kept-beside: Your text was saved as “$1”, beside this one.
conflict-failed: That didn't work. Your text is still kept; please try again.
story-empty-text: An outline is the plan of your story: sections are the big steps, cards are the moments in each step. You never need one to write.
gallery-empty-character-text: Each character has a page of their own: a name, other names, a short description, and how they relate to others.
gallery-empty-place-text: Each place has a page of its own: a name, a short description, and what happens there.
gallery-empty-note-text: Notes hold everything else about the world: history, rules, research, ideas.
gallery-empty-kind-text: Each page has a name, other names, a short description, tags, and how it relates to other pages.
kinds-hint: What your book keeps pages about. Renaming a kind changes only what Plot Device calls it; its folder stays as it is.
kinds-remove-confirm: Remove “$1” from the kinds of pages? {{PLURAL:$2|Its page stays|Its $2 pages stay}} in the book, under “Not sorted yet”. Nothing is deleted.
kinds-not-saved: That couldn’t be saved: both names are needed, and the folder must be new and usable on every computer.
kinds-unit-hint: Only Plot Device’s words change; the files and the book’s contents stay as they are. Leave both empty for “chapter”.
kinds-mismatch: Some folder names no longer match what you call them in Plot Device. This only matters if you open the book’s folder in other apps.
match-hint: Each folder gets its kind’s name. Its pages move with it, and every link to them is updated.
match-links: {{PLURAL:$1|1 link|$1 links}} in {{PLURAL:$2|1 file|$2 files}} will be updated.
match-blocked-exists: A folder with this name already exists.
match-blocked-case-only: Only capital letters differ. This one can be renamed in your file manager.
match-blocked-invalid-name: This name can’t be used for a folder.
match-blocked-other-files: The folder has files that aren’t pages, so it stays as it is.
match-backup-hint: Renaming changes many files at once. Keep a copy of the whole book first.
match-backup-failed: The backup couldn’t be made there.
match-nothing: None of these folders can be renamed right now.
folders-undone: The folder names are back as they were.
folders-undo-stale: Some files changed since, so the folder names stay as they are.
story-manuscript-hint: The reading order, as the book has it. Chapters are arranged in Write.
outline-guide: Sections are the big steps of your story. Cards are the moments in each step. Add details under a card.
outline-text-hint: Type freely: Enter adds a card, Tab makes it a detail, and $2 makes a line a section. @ links a page. $1 goes back.
outline-text-kept: {{PLURAL:$1|One passage|$1 passages}} will show “kept as written” on the board.
item-link-hint: Type @ to link a character, place, note or chapter
outline-line-keys: Enter: next line · Tab: make it a detail · Shift+Tab: back out · Esc: done
line-keys-nest: Tab: make it a detail of “$1”
outline-empty: This outline is empty. Start with a section.
confirm-delete-item: Delete “$1”? Everything inside it goes too.
confirm-delete-section: Delete the section “$1” and everything in it?
kept-explanation: The board can't show this, so it stays exactly as written. Edit it in Text.
locked-item: This item shares its line with other Markdown, so it can't be moved.
invalid-details: The details at the top of this file couldn't be read. The outline still works, and they are left as they are.
outline-changed-elsewhere: This outline changed in another app. It has been reloaded; please try again.
outline-undo-refused: This outline changed in another app since your last change, so undo would overwrite it.
outline-refused-unnamed-section: Cards above the first section can't be changed this way. Move them into a section first.
outline-refused-multiline-heading: This heading is written over two lines. Rename it in a text editor.
outline-failed: That change couldn't be made. Nothing was changed.
reference-hint: The first paragraph is the description; everything after it is details.
reference-failed: That page couldn't be changed. Nothing was changed.
prompt-relationship-words: How is $1 related to $2? For example: Sister of
relationship-changed-elsewhere: This page changed in another app. It has been reloaded; please try again.
tags-failed: The tags couldn't be changed. Nothing was changed.
tags-unreadable: The details at the top of this page can't be read, so its tags can't be changed here. Nothing was changed.
prompt-tag-rename: New name for “$1”, on {{PLURAL:$2|one page|$2 pages}}. An existing tag's name merges the two.
confirm-tag-remove: Remove the tag “$1” from {{PLURAL:$2|one page|$2 pages}}? The pages themselves stay.
tag-retagged-skipped: Changed on {{PLURAL:$1|one page|$1 pages}}. {{PLURAL:$2|One page|$2 pages}} couldn't be changed: $3.
tidy-duplicates: These look like the same tag
tidy-unreadable: Pages whose tags can't be read
linked-from-none: Nothing links here yet. On a card, “Link to…” adds a link.
arc-start-hint: A new outline for $1’s story, linked to this page
shelf-search: Find a character, place or note
shelf-empty: Search, or pin a page to keep it here.
link-search: Find a chapter, character, place or note
versions-none: No earlier versions yet. They are kept as you write, at most every ten minutes.
versions-restore-detail: What you have now is kept as a version, so this can be undone.
versions-restored: The earlier version is back. What you had is kept as a version.
versions-stale: This file changed in another app since you opened its versions. Nothing was restored.
versions-failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.
compiled-missing: The book was saved as “$1”, without these missing chapters: $2.
compile-failed: The book couldn't be saved there. Nothing was changed.
about-license: Plot Device is free software: you may use, study, share and change it under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
about-yours: Everything you write with Plot Device is yours, under your own copyright. The licence covers the program, never your writing.
update-failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection, or try again later.
settings-check-updates-hint: Once a day, Plot Device asks GitHub whether a newer version is out. Nothing about you or your writing is sent.
settings-plain-text: Show plain text when I open a page
settings-plain-text-hint: Every mark shows, for fixing things by hand. When this is off, pages show formatted text.
about-coffee: Plot twist: this app runs on coffee. ☕ If Plot Device helps you write, you can $1. I'll put it toward the next chapter… of the code.
timeline-columns-from: Column names come from the main outline:
timeline-columns-hint: Click a name to rename it; + adds a section.
timeline-rename-column: A section of $1. Click to rename it.
main-swap-question: Make “$1” the main outline? The timeline’s columns will take the names of its sections. Nothing in your outlines changes: not the text, not the line-ups. You can switch back at any time.
timeline-hidden: {{PLURAL:$1|One storyline is hidden.|$1 storylines are hidden.}}
timeline-cant-line-up-missing: Can’t line up: “$1” isn’t there any more.
timeline-cant-line-up-order: Can’t line up with “$1”: it would put this storyline out of order.
timeline-one-text: Make an outline for a character, a place or the past, and line up a few of its moments with this one. Everything else falls in between.
timeline-drag-section: Drag onto a moment to line it up
